stocks:AMZN.recent: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan failed minutes after liftoff and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites, a setback for Amazon's satellite network. The launcher later blamed the rocket's fuel supply, not Blue Origin's engines. Nothing else here concerns Amazon's own business, and none of it explains the earlier swings.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.
stocks:DBK.DE.recent: The shares dropped after a leak of 15 million internal files showed Deutsche Bank had kept about 28,000 flagged clients, and a May 2020 memo tied two Trump companies to laundromats. Later files showed staff excusing Brazilian clients and softening slave-labour allegations against Cutrale.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, joining the Chase consumer bank to one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its shares are read as a gauge of US credit, consumer spending and dealmaking.
stocks:JPM.recent: Chase's systems failed for the third time in a week on Monday, when nearly 5,000 customers reported outages to Downdetector and Zelle payments stalled. Three days later hackers took customer data from JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard through a vendor the three payment giants share.

poly-will-jensen-huang-rejoin-nvidia-by-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, who co-founded NVIDIA and ran it as chief executive for three decades, returns to the company before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for a yes.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The English Wikipedia article on artificial intelligence: software that learns from data to reason, write, see and act. How many open it each day shows how far the subject reaches beyond the people building it.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: The fortnight ran through Nvidia: Jensen Huang's 'confession' email to staff over an affair raised the question of whether he keeps the job, and Washington licensed Nvidia and AMD chips to military-listed Chinese firms. Then the Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday, erasing all of 2026's gains. None of it dates to the early-November peak.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, the Mac and a large paid-services business, and one of the most valuable companies listed on the Nasdaq. The iPhone still brings in about half of its revenue.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple's own news in the window was operational, not financial. It said an internal update caused the outage that hit its services in the same week Gmail went down. Thai officials also met the company over spyware alerts sent to politicians. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:CVX.standing: One of the two largest US oil companies, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia's LNG plants and refining it into fuel. Its share price tracks oil prices and its spending on new supply.

stocks:XOM.standing: The largest US oil and gas company, pumping crude and natural gas worldwide and refining it into fuels and chemicals. Its shares move with the oil price and with refining margins.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest energy company, producing oil and gas worldwide and ranking among the biggest traders of liquefied natural gas, with a growing power and renewables arm. This series is its New York listing, priced in dollars.
stocks:TTE.recent: West Coast fishers at Port Nolloth have taken TotalEnergies' offshore drilling to the High Court, and the judgment is still pending. Nothing else here concerns the company's own business, and the undecided case does not account for the share's slide.

poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Emmanuel Macron's prime minister from 2020 to 2022 and founder of the Horizons party, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the first Macron cannot contest.
poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.recent: The one French poll in the fortnight came from Ifop, which put Le Pen at 32-36% and Mélenchon at 17-19.5%. That leaves the centre stalled between them, and the centre is the lane Philippe needs to reach a runoff.

stocks:VALE.standing: Brazil's largest miner and one of the world's biggest iron ore producers, also mining nickel and copper. Its shares trade in New York and follow Chinese steel demand, the main buyer of its ore.

stocks:BRKM5.SA.standing: Brazil's largest petrochemical company and the biggest maker of thermoplastic resins in the Americas, controlled jointly by Novonor and Petrobras. Its profits ride the spread between naphtha feedstock and plastic resin prices.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port where Yemen's internationally recognised government sits, by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders bet on the war's front reaching the south.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: The fighting moved toward the city without reaching it: government forces withdrew from the area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving the Houthis holding that coast, and the Saudi-led coalition answered with strikes on 60 Houthi military sites while Taiz saw fierce battles. None of it put Houthi forces inside Aden.

stocks:TTWO.standing: The New York video game publisher that owns Rockstar Games and 2K, behind Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption and NBA 2K, plus Zynga's mobile titles. Its share price turns on the timing and sales of a few blockbuster releases.
stocks:TTWO.recent: The price turns on Grand Theft Auto VI, which launched to rave reviews after a 13-year wait and then sold 17 million copies, $3.79 billion in a single day. Those figures arrived after the last close on the chart. In the run-up, Rockstar fired 31 unionising UK staff.

stocks:JD.standing: A Beijing-based online retailer that, unlike marketplace rivals, owns much of the stock it sells and runs its own warehouse and delivery network. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade as a gauge of Chinese household spending.
stocks:JD.recent: The slide came before JD.com reported its quarter. The results, a return to profit with a 5.2 billion yuan operating profit and a pullback from food delivery, were published on 2026-11-19, the day after the chart ends, so nothing in them accounts for the fall shown here.

stocks:PANW.standing: One of the largest cybersecurity companies, selling firewalls and network and cloud security software to businesses and governments. Its shares are a read on how much companies spend defending their systems against attack.
stocks:PANW.recent: Palo Alto bought Applied Compute for $4.5bn on the view that open-weight AI models, which went from under 5% to over 60% of token usage in a year, leave enterprises securing models they host themselves. Nikesh Arora put that market in the hundreds of billions, and Stifel reiterated Buy after a strong Q1.

stocks:SONY.standing: US-listed shares of Sony Group, the Tokyo conglomerate behind PlayStation, Sony Music and Sony Pictures, and the biggest maker of smartphone camera sensors. Games and music now earn it more than electronics do.
stocks:SONY.recent: Sony's PlayStation network went down and was back online hours before Grand Theft Auto VI's US launch, and the game has since sold 17 million copies. Neither event accounts for the share's rise.

stocks:LMT.standing: The largest US defence contractor, maker of the F-35 fighter, missile systems and NASA's Orion crew capsule. Most of its revenue comes from the US government, so its shares move on Pentagon budgets and large contract awards.
stocks:LMT.recent: What the news did carry on the company came after its October swings: the rocket venture Lockheed Martin shares with Boeing failed minutes after launch, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites, and the Artemis change left Orion to be pushed by Starship at up to 1 g. Neither accounts for the share price.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital's mayoralty has been a springboard to Taiwan's presidency, and the KMT has held it for most terms.

stocks:OHB.DE.standing: A Bremen-based space company listed in Frankfurt, and Europe's third satellite builder after Airbus and Thales. It builds the Galileo navigation satellites, so its fortunes ride on European Space Agency and EU budgets.
stocks:OHB.DE.recent: The one story about OHB's own business came at the end of the slide: the European Space Agency ordered a €102m satellite catcher, ClearSpace-1, with the work centred on Bremen. The order arrived after the fall, and nothing in the input explains the drop from late October.

stocks:V.standing: Visa runs the world's largest card payment network and earns a small fee on each transaction under its brand. It lends no money itself, so its revenue tracks consumer spending and cross-border travel.
stocks:V.recent: Hackers who broke into a vendor took customer data from Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan. The cyberattack reached the card networks through a supplier rather than through their own systems. Nothing else in the input concerns Visa's own business, and it does not account for the earlier swings.

stocks:MA.standing: One of the two global card networks, alongside Visa. It does not lend; it takes a small fee on each payment routed over its rails, so its shares track consumer spending and cross-border travel.
stocks:MA.recent: Hackers broke into a vendor that serves JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard and took customer data from all three payment giants. Nothing in the input about the company's own business accounts for the earlier swing in its shares.

poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for the South African Reserve Bank raising its repo rate, the rate it lends to banks at, by a quarter point in January. South African prime lending rates on mortgages and car loans move with it.
poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.recent: The SARB held in Pretoria, but 3 of 7 rate-setters voted to hike from 7.25%, so one more vote turns a hold into a rise. The split came the same week Fed minutes showed almost all officials expect more rate hikes, after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October.

stocks:AMD.standing: A Santa Clara chip designer that makes processors and graphics chips for PCs, game consoles and data centres, and the main challenger to Nvidia in the accelerators used to train and run AI models.
stocks:AMD.recent: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security licensed hundreds of thousands of advanced Nvidia and AMD GPUs to firms the Department of War lists as Chinese military companies: one arm of Washington blacklists the buyers, another approved the sales. Few of those chips shipped, and Chinese clouds have moved on to domestic silicon.

stocks:LHA.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's flag carrier, parent of Swiss, Austrian and Brussels Airlines, traded in Frankfurt. Jet fuel and pay for pilots and cabin crew are its largest costs, so oil prices and strikes move the stock.
stocks:LHA.DE.recent: Lufthansa said it will cut 1,000 full-time jobs at its loss-making mainline airline at the Munich and Frankfurt hubs, after the flagship lost €180 million in nine months, and named high jet fuel costs as the pressure. The announcement came after the shares' climb and does not explain it.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: The Wikipedia article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency capped at 21 million coins and recorded on a public ledger that no bank or government controls.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Bitcoin erased its $87,000 rebound and fell below $60,000, touching $57,716, as Fed hikes and a tech selloff drained risk assets and BlackRock's bitcoin fund posted a record $541 million outflow. The slide began when MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, and $1.3 billion of crypto futures were liquidated in 24 hours.

poly-will-dominique-de-villepin-be-on-th.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Dominique de Villepin, Jacques Chirac's former prime minister, makes the first-round ballot of France's 2027 presidential election. Getting on it takes 500 sponsorships from elected officials.
poly-will-dominique-de-villepin-be-on-th.recent: Villepin, who opposed the Iraq war, announced in Paris that he is running for president, turning a possible candidacy into a declared one. The contract still pays only if he reaches the ballot, so traders are betting on whether a declared run survives to the first round.

stocks:BLK.standing: The world's largest asset manager, behind the iShares exchange-traded funds. It earns fees on the money it manages, so its shares rise and fall with the markets that money sits in and with flows into its products.
stocks:BLK.recent: The one story about BlackRock's own business was a record $541 million outflow from its bitcoin fund as bitcoin fell below $65,000. It came after the last close on the chart, and nothing else in the period accounts for the share price.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and one of the world's biggest makers of memory chips, alongside phones and displays. It is the heaviest weight in the Kospi, so its share moves with the global chip cycle and drags the market with it.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: A selloff in AI stocks hit the memory makers hardest, and Samsung and SK Hynix led the Kospi to a fall of more than 5%. Separately, Samsung was reported in buyout talks with Modine, whose own shares jumped the most in six years on the news.

stocks:7974.T.standing: The Kyoto maker of the Switch consoles and the Mario and Zelda franchises, listed in Tokyo. Most of its sales are abroad, so the share moves on hardware sell-through, its game release slate and the yen.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: One of the world's two largest makers of memory chips, based in South Korea and part of the SK Group. Its high-bandwidth memory sits beside the processors in AI data centres, so its shares trade as a bet on AI spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: SK Hynix is working around the clock to finish its first fab in Yongin, a plant that will stand 150 metres tall. A day after this reading, an AI selloff took the Kospi down more than 5%, with SK Hynix and Samsung leading the fall. Neither story accounts for the earlier slide.

stocks:BAYN.DE.standing: A German group selling prescription drugs, consumer medicines, seeds and crop chemicals, the last largely through Monsanto, bought in 2018. Lawsuits over its Roundup weedkiller have shaped its share price since.
stocks:BAYN.DE.recent: A US judge approved Bayer's $7.25bn class settlement of claims that Roundup's glyphosate caused non-Hodgkin lymphoma. It binds future claimants too, capping the liability bought with Monsanto in 2018, and pays sick users $10,000 to $165,000 each. The ruling came after the last close on the chart, so it does not explain the rise.

poly-will-the-riemann-hypothesis-be-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether an AI system will be credited with proving the Riemann Hypothesis, the 1859 conjecture on how prime numbers are distributed and one of the Clay Institute's $1 million Millennium Prize problems.

stocks:1211.HK.standing: China's biggest-selling carmaker, building battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars and the batteries inside them. Its Hong Kong shares trade on the price war at home and the tariff walls its exports meet abroad.
stocks:1211.HK.recent: Both stories about BYD's own business ran after the slide had already happened: a new car whose steering wheel folds away for autonomous driving, and a scaled-back India push after 6,755 electric car registrations there this year. Neither explains the decline.

stocks:BTCS.standing: A Nasdaq-listed company that holds ether as its corporate treasury and runs validators on the Ethereum network, so its shares rise and fall with the price of ether.
stocks:BTCS.recent: To keep its $64 million Aave loan healthy, BTCS sold ether at a loss, shrinking the treasury its shares rest on. It now says it can't rule out liquidation of a $54 million loan, which would mean the lender selling the ether pledged against it.

stocks:TME.standing: China's biggest music-streaming business, running QQ Music, Kugou and Kuwo, controlled by Tencent and listed in New York. Its shares trade on paying-subscriber growth and on licensing terms with the major record labels.
stocks:TME.recent: Tencent Music's third-quarter results, with revenue of 8.94bn yuan lifted by acquisitions and merchandise sales, came out on Nov 21, after this window closed, so they do not explain the moves shown here. Nothing else in the input covers the company's own business over these weeks.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if the United States and Iran sign a final nuclear agreement by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, strikes and statements from both capitals.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.recent: Iran's foreign minister said its 60% uranium stockpile stays home. Iran struck Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm. Qatar, the mediator in the US-Iran talks, condemned attacks on economic facilities. Separately, state media showed an underground missile city.

stocks:TSLA.standing: The American electric-car maker run by Elon Musk, and the most valuable carmaker in the world by market value. Its share trades on bets about self-driving, robotaxis and Musk himself more than on the cars it sells.
stocks:TSLA.recent: The slide came before the month's company news did. Afterwards Tesla said it would discontinue the Cybertruck, opened Cybercab orders to select customers and won Italian approval for its driver assistance, and Bloomberg reported that SpaceX and Tesla were weighing a merger announcement in December. None of it explains the earlier fall.

poly-will-ai-solve-the-riemann-hypothesi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if an AI system is credited with solving the Riemann Hypothesis, the 1859 conjecture about how prime numbers are distributed and among mathematics' most famous open problems, before 2026 ends.
poly-will-ai-solve-the-riemann-hypothesi.recent: The jump followed a proof of the Riemann hypothesis that software verified in Lean before any human had read it through. Machine checking settles whether each step follows, but whether the result is credited to an AI, and accepted by mathematicians, is what the contract turns on.

wiki-houthi-movement.standing: Ansar Allah, the Zaidi Shia armed movement from Yemen's far north that has held the capital Sanaa since 2014. Aligned with Iran, it fights a Saudi-led coalition and can reach shipping through the Red Sea.
wiki-houthi-movement.recent: Yemeni government forces withdrew from the Bab el-Mandeb coast, leaving the Houthis holding the Red Sea's southern chokepoint, the same day they claimed a missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid Airport. Saudi-led strikes on Hodeidah and nightly Houthi missiles over Riyadh followed, and 22 countries' coastguards agreed to patrol the Red Sea jointly.

stocks:ALK.standing: The Seattle-based parent of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines, with a network built around the US West Coast, Alaska and Hawaii. Its share price moves on jet fuel costs and on demand for leisure travel to the islands.

stocks:XPEV.standing: A Guangzhou electric-car maker listed in New York and Hong Kong, selling sedans and SUVs built around its own driver-assistance software. Volkswagen holds a stake, and its shares trade on the course of China's EV price war.
stocks:XPEV.recent: Xpeng's quarterly results came in at a record 24.28 billion yuan in revenue and still ended in a loss: it is selling more cars than ever without yet making money on them. The figures were published after the slide on the chart, so they do not explain it.

stocks:VWAGY.standing: Europe's largest carmaker by sales, based in Wolfsburg, Germany, and owner of Audi, Porsche, Skoda and SEAT. China is its biggest market, so its shares move on Chinese demand and on the cost of its shift to electric cars.
stocks:VWAGY.recent: The news on Volkswagen's own business was its software bill. Cariad, the in-house unit built to write the code for its cars, kept losing money, and Volkswagen is now buying that software from Rivian, which booked $354 million from Volkswagen in a single quarter.

poly-will-nicols-maduro-be-the-leader-of.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Nicolás Maduro still leads Venezuela when 2026 ends. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, a running bet on whether the government in Caracas holds.

poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the San Francisco maker of the Claude AI models, goes bankrupt by the end of 2027. Traders use it to bet on whether frontier-model costs outrun the capital raised.

wiki-pakistan.standing: Daily reads of the Wikipedia article on Pakistan, the world's fifth most populous country and a nuclear-armed state bordering India, Afghanistan, Iran and China.
wiki-pakistan.recent: Islamabad hosted an ECO ministerial in mid-November, where Araghchi met the Pakistani PM and to which Pakistan did not invite Afghanistan. Jailed ex-leader Imran Khan appealed for urgent medical care the same week. Days later a Pakistani minister landed in New Delhi, the first in India since the 2025 war, as Oman lent Pakistan State Oil $200m for fuel.

stocks:VOW3.DE.standing: Europe's largest carmaker, owner of Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Skoda and Seat, with China among its biggest markets. Its shares carry Germany's industrial exposure to tariffs, electric-car costs and Chinese rivals.
stocks:VOW3.DE.recent: The one story here about Volkswagen's own business is the software it is buying from Rivian, which booked $354 million from Volkswagen in one quarter for code the carmaker could not build itself. That report came after the slide, and nothing in the input accounts for the share price.

stocks:603019.SS.standing: Sugon, listed in Shanghai, is one of China's main builders of servers and supercomputers. It has been on the US export blacklist since 2019, so its share trades as a bet on China computing without American chips.
stocks:603019.SS.recent: A 100,000-card Chinese supercluster in Zhengzhou won the Gordon Bell Prize, the top award in high-performance computing, for a cluster built entirely from domestic hardware. The prize was reported after the chart's last close, so it does not account for the share's path over the window.

stocks:RIVN.standing: An American maker of electric pickups, SUVs and Amazon's delivery vans, listed on Nasdaq. It has yet to turn a profit, so its share price trades on cash burn, production targets and its software partnership with Volkswagen.
stocks:RIVN.recent: The one story about Rivian's own business was a revenue line, not a setback: Volkswagen paid it $354 million in one quarter for software the German carmaker could not build itself. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-tucker-carlson-win-the-2028-re.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Tucker Carlson, the former Fox News host turned independent broadcaster, becomes the Republican presidential nominee in 2028. Its price is what bettors will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-dem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Kamala Harris, the 2024 Democratic presidential nominee, wins her party's nomination again for 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: The fortnight's American political news was the midterm result, in which Democrats secured their largest House majority in three decades. None of it concerned Marco Rubio himself, and nothing in it accounts for the contract's drift.

stocks:DAL.standing: Delta Air Lines, one of the three largest US carriers, run from its Atlanta hub, the world's busiest airport. Its shares move on jet fuel prices and on how many people fly, corporate travellers above all.
stocks:DAL.recent: A failure of Delta's weight-and-balance system grounded its flights out of Atlanta on Nov 22, with 48% of them running late as Thanksgiving travel built. The outage came after the chart's last close, though, so it does not account for the line.

stocks:7201.T.standing: Japan's third-largest carmaker, based in Yokohama and listed in Tokyo. It sells heavily in China and the United States, so its shares move on tariffs, the yen and the state of its long alliance with Renault.
stocks:7201.T.recent: Toyota, Nissan and Honda agreed to standardise parts from 2027, but that came after the last close shown, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share's swings.

stocks:7203.T.standing: The world's largest carmaker by vehicles sold, and the most valuable company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Most of its profit is earned abroad, so a stronger yen cuts into its earnings and its share price.
stocks:7203.T.recent: Toyota, Nissan and Honda agreed to standardise parts from 2027, but that came after the last close on this chart and does not account for its swings.

stocks:7267.T.standing: Japan's second-largest carmaker and the world's biggest maker of motorcycles, listed in Tokyo. Most of its profit is earned abroad, in the US and in Asian motorcycle markets, so a weaker yen lifts what it reports.
stocks:7267.T.recent: The only news about Honda's own business arrived after the slide: it will standardise parts with Toyota and Nissan from 2027, an agreement that does not explain the fall in the share.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's top leadership changes hands before the year ends. It is what traders will stake on the Islamic Republic's ruling order breaking, a question that reaches Gulf shipping and the oil price.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.recent: The news from Iran showed a state pressing outward rather than one changing hands. It struck Bahrain and Kuwait, state media showed an underground missile base, and talks went on in Qatar under the US blockade. None of it bears on who rules in Tehran, and none of it accounts for the price.

wiki-federal-reserve.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on the Federal Reserve, the US central bank. It sets the overnight rate that dollar borrowing worldwide is priced from, so its decisions reach mortgages, currencies and gold.
wiki-federal-reserve.recent: October's core consumer prices rose 0.3%, Logan called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly, and two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points on fears of a half-point move. The minutes showed almost all officials expecting more hikes, Goolsbee left a larger rise open for December, and Bessent warned of overtightening.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate a quarter point at its January 2027 meeting: a bet on how long US tightening runs, the question behind Treasury yields and borrowing costs.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: Hotter October inflation, with consumer prices up 0.4%, set the bets running: Logan called for two more hikes, Deutsche Bank forecast three straight, and Fed minutes showed almost all officials expect more. The AI-led stock rout then killed wagers on a half-point move in December, and Bessent warned the Fed risks overtightening.

stocks:APLAPOLLO.NS.standing: India's largest maker of structural steel tubes. It buys hot-rolled coil from mills and sells hollow sections to builders, so its margin lives in the gap between steel prices and construction demand.
stocks:APLAPOLLO.NS.recent: Tata Steel's board approved buying 26.38% of APL Apollo Tubes for about ₹15,510 crore ($1.7bn), with an open offer for another 26% that puts control within its reach. The steelmaker is buying one of its own customers to keep the downstream margin, and paying with debt while its own margins are under pressure.

stocks:TATASTEEL.NS.standing: India's oldest private steelmaker and part of the Tata group, with plants in India, the Netherlands and Britain. Its shares move on coking coal costs, Chinese steel exports and Indian construction demand.
stocks:TATASTEEL.NS.recent: Tata Steel's board approved buying 26.38% of APL Apollo Tubes for about ₹15,510 crore ($1.7bn), plus an open offer for another 26%, a route to control of India's largest structural-steel-tube maker. A steelmaker is buying its own customer for the downstream margin, with debt, and APL Apollo shares fell more than 15%.

poly-alice-huang-federally-charged-by-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if US federal prosecutors charge Alice Huang before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reporting about any inquiry into her.
poly-alice-huang-federally-charged-by-de.recent: The only reporting on Huang came at the end of the fortnight: a report from Washington that she kept a Chinese intelligence contact, linking her to Beijing. It arrived after the contract had already fallen, and nothing earlier in the input explains why traders were paying less for federal charges.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by Dec 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-ai-solve-0-more-millennium-pri.standing: Bets on whether AI fails to crack another of the seven $1 million Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000 before the year ends. Only one, the Poincaré conjecture, has ever been solved, by a human.

poly-will-magdalena-andersson-be-the-nex.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Magdalena Andersson, the Social Democrat who led Sweden's government in 2021–22, becomes its next prime minister. The post goes to whoever can assemble a Riksdag majority that will not vote them down.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: Iran's parallel armed force, founded after the 1979 revolution to protect the clerical system rather than the borders. It runs the missile and drone arsenals, a navy in the Gulf, and the Quds Force that arms allies abroad.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: Bahrain faced its third Iranian drone attack in a week, a day after the Guard said 2 tankers hit mines in Hormuz. In Brooklyn, Asif Merchant received 330 months for plotting to kill Donald Trump. None of the 30-plus mine hits Iran claims has been verified, yet one transit now costs $64m to insure.

stocks:0100.HK.standing: Shanghai-based developer of large language and video-generation models, listed in Hong Kong. It is one of the Chinese AI startups that compete with US labs on frontier models, and it trades on how investors price that contest.
stocks:0100.HK.recent: The company's own news was about its research and its hiring. It listed 16 openings in San Francisco as Chinese labs recruited Americans, and its AI recovered 94 McEliece challenge keys. Neither story accounts for the share's slide, and the second came after the trough.

poly-will-nvidia-be-the-largest-company-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if NVIDIA is the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation on December 31. It tracks a race decided by a few trillion-dollar tech firms, where AI chip demand sets NVIDIA's place.

stocks:IBM.standing: The New York-listed share of IBM, which earns most of its money selling software, consulting and mainframe servers to banks, governments and airlines. It is also one of the largest corporate backers of quantum computing.
stocks:IBM.recent: IBM scaled back its quantum plans, saying it would link two chips into a 1,040-qubit system offered from 2027. After the last reading, IBM Consulting ended US visa and green-card sponsorship and offered its immigrant workers roles abroad. Neither story accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if Iran shuts all of its airspace before year-end. Flights between Europe, the Gulf and Asia cross Iranian skies, so a full closure would force airlines onto longer routes around it.
poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-decem.recent: The fighting moved to the sea and the Gulf: mines and tanker fires off Hormuz, Iranian strikes on Bahrain and Kuwait, and an Iranian claim to have hit a US F-16 that CENTCOM denies, while talks went on in Qatar. None of the reporting has Tehran closing its own skies, and none of it explains why traders marked the bet down.

stocks:R3NK.DE.standing: An Augsburg maker of transmissions for tanks and armoured vehicles, plus naval and industrial gearboxes. Its order book follows European defence budgets, because most Western main battle tanks run on its drivetrains.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio wins the Republican nomination for the 2028 US presidential race. Its price is what traders will pay, in cents on the dollar, to bet on that outcome.

wiki-israel.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Israel each day. Israel is a state on the eastern Mediterranean founded in 1948, and its wars and coalition politics regularly draw readers from far outside the region.
wiki-israel.recent: Coalition talks between Likud and Eisenkot's Yashar ended without a deal, Yashar refusing to govern alongside Itamar Ben-Gvir. In Gaza, Israel launched its first large operation since the ceasefire, and the Board of Peace warned the truce faced collapse. Britain froze the assets of 8 settlement builders.

stocks:ETL.PA.standing: A Paris-listed satellite operator that owns OneWeb, a low-orbit broadband constellation, alongside an older fleet of geostationary satellites. It is Europe's main rival to Starlink, so government and defence demand drives its shares.
stocks:ETL.PA.recent: Eutelsat won a contract with the US Space Force for service over its OneWeb network. The deal builds on hardware the Pentagon already has in place: the US military owns more than 500 OneWeb terminals.

stocks:MSTR.standing: Formerly MicroStrategy, a Virginia business-software firm that made itself the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, buying coins with money raised from shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on bitcoin.
stocks:MSTR.recent: MSCI dropped Strategy from its indexes, which pushes the funds that track them to sell and undercuts the share-issuing model the company buys coins with. Then bitcoin fell to a two-year low near $55,000 after the $6.3bn Binance hack the FBI blames on North Korea, and Strategy's enterprise value slipped below the worth of its 851,305 bitcoin.
